name: @w6w-apps/wati
description: Send WhatsApp template and session messages, manage contacts, and read conversations through Wati's WhatsApp Business API.

w6w.longDescription:
Wati is a WhatsApp Team Inbox and Business API platform: a shared inbox for human agents plus a REST API for sending template and session messages, managing contacts, and reading conversation history. Like `kintone`, `mautic` and `tableau` in this pack, every Wati customer runs their own tenant — the API is reached at a per-tenant host and path (e.g. `https://live-mt-server.wati.io/<tenantId>`) copied from the customer's own Wati account, so the tenant's own API endpoint is a connection field rather than a fixed host.

This app covers Wati's recommended API V3 surface (`/api/ext/v3/...`, the version Wati's own docs tell new integrations to use over the legacy V1/V2 paths): sending a free-form session text or file message into an active 24-hour conversation, sending an approved WhatsApp template message to one or more recipients, contact CRUD (list, get, create, bulk-update custom fields, delete) plus a contact count, reading a conversation's message history, listing approved message templates, and reading the tenant's own credit balance.

Every path, verb and field here was verified 2026-09-05 against the OpenAPI 3.0.4 document Wati's own ReadMe-hosted API reference (`docs.wati.io`) embeds per-endpoint (`info.title: "WhatsApp chat API"`, `info.version: "v3"`), not a third-party integration directory. See the README for what was deliberately left out (interactive/list/product messages, broadcasts, calls, WhatsApp groups, chatbots, sales analytics, segments, posts/comments) and the vendor quirks that shaped the design.
